title: Quilt-LLaVA: Visual Instruction Tuning by Extracting Localized Narratives from Open-Source Histopathology Videos
authors_zh: Mehmet Saygin Seyfioglu, Wisdom O. Ikezogwo, Fatemeh Ghezloo, Ranjay Krishna, Linda Shapiro
paper_type_zh: 开放指令数据集与构造方法研究
best_for_zh: 训练能够解释可见形态证据的病理图像助手
one_line: Quilt-LLaVA converts localized narration from open pathology videos into 107K image-question-explanation records.
Quilt-LLaVA 把开放病理视频中的局部专家讲解转换成 10.7 万条图像、问题与解释记录。
why: mining expert temporal narration as localized visual demonstrations
inclusion_reason: QUILT-LLaVA-Instruct-107K is a public Track 01 training object: pathology image crop, localized narrative or question, and diagnostic/explanatory response; it is consumed by domain visual instruction SFT.

title: Problem
问题
html:
General visual-instruction corpora lack localized pathology explanations, while clinical image datasets often provide only class labels and cannot teach a model to connect morphology to language.

The paper's decision boundary is the released QUILT-LLaVA-Instruct-107K training object, not a model-only report or an evaluation-only benchmark. One record contains pathology image crop, localized narrative or question, and diagnostic/explanatory response; its selection boundary is temporal/text localization, pathology terminology checks, and downstream VQA evaluation, and the records are consumed by domain visual instruction SFT.

L4 facts: the official CVPR 2024 page, public records at https://huggingface.co/datasets/wisdomik/QUILT-LLaVA-Instruct-107K, release scale and terms were checked on 2026-07-27. The paper is included because its central contribution directly constructs or curates serialized post-training targets.

通用视觉指令语料缺少局部病理解释，而临床图像数据常只有类别标签，无法教会模型把形态证据连接到语言。

流程把视频讲解与病理帧对齐，将局部叙述改写为 10.7 万条指令回答记录，再用这些带证据的对话微调视觉语言模型。 该方法直接产出 QUILT-LLaVA-Instruct-107K。本卡的决策边界是可下载训练记录，而不是只有模型的报告或只用于评测的基准；单条记录包含 病理图像裁剪、局部讲解或问题，以及诊断或解释型回答。

L4 事实：已于 2026-07-27 核验 CVPR 2024 官方页面、https://huggingface.co/datasets/wisdomik/QUILT-LLaVA-Instruct-107K 的实际公开记录、规模和条款。收录理由是论文中心贡献直接构造或筛选可序列化的后训练目标。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The pipeline aligns video narration to selected pathology frames, converts localized narratives into 107K instruction-response records, and tunes LLaVA on the resulting evidence-rich domain conversations. The closest comparison is generic LLaVA instruction data and label-only pathology collections; unlike that neighbor, the primary object here is QUILT-LLaVA-Instruct-107K and the feedback boundary is temporal/text localization, pathology terminology checks, and downstream VQA evaluation, which makes this an instruction/demonstration data paper rather than a model-architecture-only entry.

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1 - Source the task substrate. Input: open histopathology educational videos aligned at frame and transcript-segment level. Operation: Normalize source identifiers, media or task inputs, and target fields into the release schema. Output and transition: Candidate records containing pathology image crop, localized narrative or question, and diagnostic/explanatory response advance to target construction. Check / stop rule: Reject missing inputs, targets, or source provenance.

Step 2 - Write or transform the target. Input: The normalized candidate and its source evidence. Operation: localized expert narration, transformed into questions and answers with language-model assistance produces or supplies the target while preserving fields needed for audit. Output and transition: A serialized instruction, demonstration, caption, rationale, or response advances to verification. Check / stop rule: A target that cannot be tied back to its input or source annotation is not retained.

Step 3 - Verify and package. Input: Generated or transformed candidates. Operation: Apply temporal/text localization, pathology terminology checks, and downstream VQA evaluation; deduplicate and assign release splits where documented. Output and transition: Passing records form 107,000 histopathology visual-instruction records stored as Parquet records with image pointers, questions, and answers and advance to training use. Check / stop rule: Keep only records that pass the stated correctness, grounding, format, or selection contract.

Step 4 - Consume the data. Input: The released records and the paper's chosen base model. Operation: Use them for domain visual instruction SFT and compare against generic LLaVA instruction data and label-only pathology collections. Output and transition: A trained checkpoint and controlled evidence about the data intervention become the final evaluated artifacts. Check / stop rule: Judge both target-task quality and regression on general capabilities; no universal early-stopping threshold is disclosed.

Reproducibility requires pinning source revisions, the public manifest, transformation prompts, teacher version, filters, split, base checkpoint, and evaluation harness. The complete generation budget is not disclosed.

步骤 1——取得任务底材。 输入：论文核验过的公开任务、媒体、文档或已有指令来源。 操作：统一来源编号、输入和目标字段，并保留追踪信息。 输出及流转：候选记录进入目标构造阶段。 检查与停止规则：缺少输入、目标或来源信息的记录直接删除。

步骤 2——撰写或转换目标。 输入：规范化候选及其来源证据。 操作：流程把视频讲解与病理帧对齐，将局部叙述改写为 10.7 万条指令回答记录，再用这些带证据的对话微调视觉语言模型。 输出及流转：得到包含 病理图像裁剪、局部讲解或问题，以及诊断或解释型回答 的结构化记录，并进入验证阶段。 检查与停止规则：不能回溯到输入、来源标注或生成轮次的目标不保留。

步骤 3——验证并打包。 输入：生成或转换后的候选记录。 操作：按论文披露的正确性、执行结果、视觉落地、格式或质量信号筛选，并在有说明时去重和划分数据。 输出及流转：通过检查的 10.7 万条组织病理学视觉指令记录 以 Parquet 记录、图像引用与公开图像文件 发布，随后进入训练。 检查与停止规则：只有满足论文接受契约且必需字段完整的记录进入发布集。

步骤 4——消费数据。 输入：公开记录与论文采用的基础模型。 操作：按论文配方完成指令微调、蒸馏或相应后训练，并与最近基线比较。 输出及流转：训练后的检查点和数据干预的受控证据成为最终评估产物。 检查与停止规则：同时检查目标任务质量和通用能力回退；论文未披露统一早停阈值时不得自行补写。

复现时需固定来源修订版、公开清单、转换提示、教师版本、过滤器、切分、基础检查点和评测工具。完整端到端生成预算若未披露，应保留为未知。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Quilt-LLaVA improves histopathology question answering and zero-shot transfer relative to generic visual assistants; the dataset ablation attributes gains to localized narrative supervision rather than model scale.

Impact cross-check: OpenAlex reported 46 citations on 2026-07-27, and the official dataset exposes actual reusable records rather than only weights or examples. The count is an impact signal, not a Google Scholar citation line and not evidence that every record is correct.

相对通用视觉助手，Quilt-LLaVA 在组织病理问答和零样本迁移上更好；数据消融把主要差异定位到与图像局部对齐的专家讲解，而不是简单扩大模型。结论仍只覆盖论文所用的教育视频与评测集。

影响力交叉检查：OpenAlex 在 2026-07-27 报告 46 次引用，官方数据集也公开了可复用实际记录，而不是只有权重或样例。该数字只作为影响信号，不是 Google Scholar 引用数，也不能证明每条记录都正确。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior work baseline: generic LLaVA instruction data and label-only pathology collections. The actual change is mining expert temporal narration as localized visual demonstrations. This is a direction signal because it changes the serialized data object and its selection contract, not merely the backbone. The inherited model family, source tasks, autoregressive loss, and common benchmarks are not new. Before reuse, inspect misaligned narration can teach confident claims about features outside the crop.
相对最近的共同做法，把公开视频中的专家时序讲解挖掘为与具体病理区域对齐的视觉示范。 这改变了可审计的数据对象或选择决策，而不只是更换骨干模型。继承的模型家族、自回归训练目标和常用评测并不新；复用前还要检查 错位讲解会让模型对裁剪范围外的特征作出自信判断。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Video narration can be loosely aligned to the displayed field
  2. diagnoses reflect educational-video selection bias
  3. the data is not a substitute for clinical validation.

1. 视频讲解与屏幕中的局部视野可能并不严格同步，应抽样复核对齐。
  2. 教育视频的疾病和讲解风格具有选择偏差。
  3. 这些记录不能替代真实临床验证或患者级安全评估。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• For training a pathology assistant to explain visible morphology, use the official manifest and schema to build a controlled SFT mixture. The output should be a versioned dataset and a fixed-backbone comparison; success requires the paper's task metrics plus an audit of misaligned narration can teach confident claims about features outside the crop.
  • For data auditing, sample records across sources and reproduce the stated selection contract: temporal/text localization, pathology terminology checks, and downstream VQA evaluation. Do not reuse the release when its licensing or source provenance cannot be preserved.

• 若要训练能够解释可见形态证据的病理图像助手，可复用官方清单、记录结构和论文披露的筛选配方。输出应是带版本的数据集与固定骨干对照；成功标准除论文指标外，还要审计 错位讲解会让模型对裁剪范围外的特征作出自信判断。
  • 数据审计者应跨来源抽样，复查必需字段、接受规则和许可。若无法保留来源信息或执行相同检查，就不应直接复用。
